component.name: Vidra
component.summary: Download video and audio from YouTube and other sites
YouTube ve diğer sitelerden video ve ses indirin

description.p: Vidra is a desktop app that downloads video and audio from YouTube and the hundreds of other sites yt-dlp supports, with yt-dlp and FFmpeg bundled with the app, so nothing else needs to be installed.

ul.li: Video up to 4K as MP4, or audio as MP3 and M4A, with cover and details embedded
Every format yt-dlp lists (VP9, AV1, 60 fps, HDR, Opus) with codec and size
Pause and resume, a tray icon while downloading in the background
Playlists, clip sections and several links at once
A queue that survives restarts and a searchable download history
Browser cookies for age-restricted videos, proxy and speed limit

description.p: Only download content you have the right to download.
Closing the window always moves Vidra to the tray when "Keep running in the tray" is on, not only while downloading.

Downloads from every site yt-dlp supports, every format yt-dlp lists, pause and resume, a tray icon while downloading in the background, a free-space check, a clipboard setting and a log file with a Report a problem button.
Finished downloads get an Open folder button instead of the folder opening by itself, and on Windows the download folder opens instead of Documents.

Copied links no longer replace what is typed in the link box, downloads interrupted by closing the app resume on their own, conversions keep earlier outputs, and a second launch focuses the open window.
Clip sections, playlist folders, history search, duplicate warnings and an English interface.
